shellCommands.command: cat /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md; echo ---; ls -R /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui; echo ---; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/AGENTS.md

sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ---; grep -n -i -C 3 'markdown\|editor' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -120; echo ---PKG; cat package.json; echo ---TREE; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -50

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; echo ---TRAPS; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; echo ---ME; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; echo ---LOCK; grep -c '"node_modules/' package-lock.json; grep -n 'markdown-editor' package-lock.json | head -3
npm view @gravity-ui/markdown-editor version peerDependencies --json 2>&1 | head -60

npm install @gravity-ui/markdown-editor @gravity-ui/components @diplodoc/transform @diplodoc/cut-extension @diplodoc/file-extension @diplodoc/html-extension @diplodoc/tabs-extension @diplodoc/latex-extension @diplodoc/mermaid-extension @diplodoc/quote-link-extension @diplodoc/folding-headings-extension markdown-it highlight.js lowlight katex 2>&1 | tail -15
npm view @gravity-ui/components@">=4.10.0" version peerDependencies.@gravity-ui/uikit --json 2>&1 | grep -E '"version"|uikit' | paste - - | tail -20

npm install @gravity-ui/markdown-editor @gravity-ui/components@4.23.1 @diplodoc/transform @diplodoc/cut-extension @diplodoc/file-extension @diplodoc/html-extension @diplodoc/tabs-extension @diplodoc/latex-extension @diplodoc/mermaid-extension @diplodoc/quote-link-extension @diplodoc/folding-headings-extension markdown-it highlight.js lowlight katex 2>&1 | tail -8; echo ---; grep -A30 '"dependencies"' package.json; echo ---; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/package.json node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json
M=node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor; ls $M; ls $M/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls $M/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; echo ---README; sed -n 1,200p $M/README.md

M=node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs; cat $M/INDEX.md | head -120; echo ---GUIDES; ls $M/guides; echo ---GREP; grep -rn -i -C 3 'initial\|change\|styles.css\|import .*css' $M/INDEX.md | head -80

M=node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor; echo ---CRA; cat $M/build/docs/guides/how-to-add-editor-with-create-react-app.md | head -90; echo ---PKG-EXPORTS; grep -n -A4 '"\./styles' $M/package.json | head -30; ls $M/build/esm/*.css $M/build/cjs/*.css $M/build/styles 2>/dev/null; echo ---TYPES; find $M/build/esm -name 'useMarkdownEditor.d.ts' -o -name 'types.d.ts' -path '*bundle*' | head; echo ---HOOK; cat $(find $M/build/esm -name 'useMarkdownEditor.d.ts' | head -1); echo ---OPTS; grep -n -B2 -A50 'export type MarkdownEditorOptions\|export interface MarkdownEditorOptions' $M/build/esm/bundle/useMarkdownEditor.d.ts $M/build/esm/bundle/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -120

M=node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm; T=$M/bundle/types.d.ts; echo ---INITIAL; grep -n -A14 'export type MarkdownEditorInitialOptions' $T; echo ---MD; grep -n -A14 'export type MarkdownEditorMdOptions' $T; echo ---MODE; grep -rn 'export type MarkdownEditorMode\|export type MarkupString' $M/bundle/*.d.ts $M/*.d.ts | head; echo ---INSTANCE; grep -n -A40 'export type MarkdownEditorInstance\|export interface MarkdownEditorInstance' $M/bundle/editor-public-types.d.ts | head -60; echo ---EVENTS; grep -n -B1 -A25 'EventMap\b.*=\|interface EventMap\|type EventMap' $M/bundle/editor-public-types.d.ts $M/bundle/Editor.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; echo ---VIEW; grep -n -A40 'export type MarkdownEditorViewProps\|export interface MarkdownEditorViewProps' $M/bundle/MarkdownEditorView.d.ts | head -60; echo ---STYLES; ls $M/styles; echo ---TOASTER; grep -rln 'useToaster' $M --include=*.js | head -3; echo ---PREVIEW; sed -n 1,80p node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs/guides/how-to-add-preview.md

M=node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm; echo ---EVENTMAP; grep -rn -A20 'export type EventMap\|export interface EventMap' $M/bundle/*.d.ts | head -40; echo ---COMMON; grep -rn -A8 'export interface CommonEditor\|export type CommonEditor' $M/bundle/*.d.ts $M/core/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo ---VIEWPROPS; sed -n 1,19p $M/bundle/MarkdownEditorView.d.ts; echo ---USETOASTER; grep -n -B3 -A3 'useToaster' $M/bundle/MarkdownEditorView.js | head -30; echo ---UIKIT-TOASTER; grep -n 'Toaster' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo ---CSS-DOCS; grep -rn 'styles/' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs/ | head; grep -rn 'styles.css\|\.css' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs/guides/how-to-add-editor-with-nextjs.md | head

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; echo ---USETOASTER; cat $U/components/Toaster/hooks/useToaster.d.ts; cat $U/components/Toaster/hooks/useToaster.js; ls $U/components/Toaster/; echo ---TOASTER-INDEX; cat $U/components/Toaster/index.d.ts; echo ---COMMON; grep -rn -B2 -A12 'interface CommonEditor' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm --include=*.d.ts | head -30; echo ---TEXTINPUT; grep -n 'value\|onUpdate\|label\|placeholder\|size\|errorMessage\|validationState' $U/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts $U/components/controls/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo ---BUTTON; grep -n 'view?\|size?\|type?\|loading' $U/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head; echo ---FLEX; grep -n 'direction\|gap\|alignItems' $U/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head; echo ---TEXT; grep -n 'variant' $U/components/Text/Text.d.ts $U/components/Text/text/text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo ---CARD; grep -n 'view?\|type?\|size?' $U/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head

M=node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm; T=$M/bundle/types.d.ts; echo ---MARKUPCFG; grep -n -A30 'export type MarkdownEditorMarkupConfig' $T | head -45; echo ---RENDERPREVIEW; grep -rn -A8 'export type RenderPreview' $M/bundle/*.d.ts | head -20; echo ---INDEX-EXPORTS; grep -n 'YfmStaticView\|RenderPreview\|MarkupString\|useMarkdownEditor\|MarkdownEditorView\|configure' $M/index.d.ts $M/bundle/index.d.ts $M/view/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo ---YFMSTATIC; cat $(find $M -name 'YfmStaticView.d.ts' | head -1); echo ---TRANSFORM; grep -n -A12 'declare function transform\|export default\|^export' node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/index.d.ts | head -40; echo ---TOASTERPROVIDER; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Provider/ToasterProvider.d.ts; grep -n -A6 'declare class Toaster' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Toaster.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/ToasterComponent/ToasterComponent.d.ts | head -12

M=node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm; grep -n 'YfmStaticView\|RenderPreview\|MarkupString\|MarkdownEditorSplitMode\|MarkdownEditorOptions\|MarkdownEditorInstance' $M/index.d.ts $M/view/index.d.ts $M/view/components/index.d.ts $M/bundle/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -15; echo ---SPLIT; grep -rn 'export type MarkdownEditorSplitMode' $M/bundle/*.d.ts; echo ---OUTPUT; grep -n -A6 'interface OutputType\|type OutputType' node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/typings.d.ts | head -12; grep -n 'html:' node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/typings.d.ts | head -3
M=node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm; cat $M/index.d.ts; echo ---VIEW; grep -rn 'YfmStaticView' $M/index.d.ts $M/view/*.d.ts $M/view/components/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5

M=node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm; cat $M/view/index.d.ts; grep -rn 'YfmStaticView\|YfmHtml' $M/view/components/index.d.ts $M/view/components/YfmHtml/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n 'export.*type' $M/bundle/index.d.ts | head -20

sed -i "s/^import {useCallback, useState} from 'react';/import {type FormEvent, useCallback, useState} from 'react';/; s/event?: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>/event?: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>/" src/App.tsx && grep -n 'FormEvent' src/App.tsx; echo ---YFMCSS; grep -rln 'yfm.css\|@diplodoc/transform/dist/css' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm --include=*.js --include=*.css | head -5; echo ---BUILD; npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v 'allow-scripts' | tail -15
cat .gitignore; echo ---; git status --short
rm -rf dist && git status --short
